about.title: Blackberrylabs
about.subtitle: A small family of read-only tools for developers who run AI on Linux.
about.body: Each tool answers one question — what your agents may do, which MCP servers are declared, what the tooling left on the disk — and this screen gathers their findings in one list, most serious first.
